title: No fix for `lazy-import-mismatch` (TID254) with multiple imported things in one statement
body:
### Summary

No fix is offered for [`lazy-import-mismatch` (TID254)](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/rules/lazy-import-mismatch/) when a single statement imports multiple things. It would be more helpful for a fix to be offered, splitting the import statement into two if necessary to keep lazy and non-lazy import separate. Example:
```console
$ cat >tid254.py <<'# EOF'
import os, re
import rlcompleter, typing
from sys import stdin, stdout
# EOF

$ ruff check --preview --target-version py315 --select TID254 tid254.py --config 'lint.flake8-tidy-imports = {ban-lazy = ["rlcompleter"], require-lazy = ["os", "re", "sys", "typing"]}' --output-format concise
tid254.py:1:8: lazy-import-mismatch: `os` should be imported lazily
tid254.py:1:12: lazy-import-mismatch: `re` should be imported lazily
tid254.py:2:21: lazy-import-mismatch: `typing` should be imported lazily
tid254.py:3:1: lazy-import-mismatch: `sys` should be imported lazily
```

A helpful fix would produce:
```python
lazy import os, re
import rlcompleter
lazy import typing
lazy from sys import stdin, stdout
```

### Version

ruff 0.16.7 (b5dba861c 2026-09-10)
